_comment: Canonical capacity descriptor template. Copy this file and fill in the blanks. See capacity.dsl.reference.json for the complete DSL operator reference.

brique._cap_name_note: Required. Must exactly match the filename without .json (e.g. file 'audio.stream.json' → cap_name 'audio.stream').
brique._kind_note: Required. 'dsl' = engine executes the resolution plan. 'interpreted' or 'compiled' = wrapper executes; resolution is declarative guidance only.
brique._wrapper_note: Required when kind='interpreted' or 'compiled'. Must match a wrapper_name declared in THIS capacity's OWN context.json engine_config.execution.wrappers — resolution is strictly local per context, never inherited from a parent context's execution.wrappers, however architecturally close. A capacity cannot reference a wrapper declared one level up; fails with reason=wrapper_not_configured otherwise. To share one wrapper process across several contexts, declare the capacity itself in the wrapper-owning context's own tree and aggregate the contributing code there (see Wrapper.md §11.1) — do not expect a cross-context wrapper reference to work. Empty for kind='dsl'.
brique._rel_ctx_note: Optional. Logical sub-context inside the wrapper domain. Leave empty when not needed.
brique._lang_note: Informational. 'brique_dsl' for kind='dsl'. Actual language (e.g. 'python', 'go') for kind='interpreted' or 'compiled'.

objective._comment: Optional but recommended. Characterizes what this capacity is: name, description and any nested semantic keys (a first key, then sub-keys) that qualify its meaning. These paths are projected by the reflexive layer and are what make it discoverable by meaning. How it works belongs in 'functional', not here.
objective.name: <cap_name>
objective.description: One sentence describing what this capacity does.

functional._comment: How this capacity works, never what it is (that belongs in 'objective'). Exactly one root section required (key starting with '#'). Additional named sub-sections (#name) may appear inside resolution at any depth.

#root.role: One sentence describing the transformation performed by this capacity.

params._list_note: A parameter that is a list is declared with type 'array': one level, its elements are given to the capacity in order, each travelling as a parameter would. The type of the elements is not declared.

<param_name>.type: string | integer | boolean | array | object | any

@matter._comment: Optional. Declare matter slots the caller must bind. Keys are logical slot names, not concrete matter IDs.
@matter._cardinality_note: Optional, 'one' (default) or 'many': the same key and values as in a schema. A 'many' slot receives an ordered list of Matters under its name: the caller binds them as repeated entries, in order; hosted code reads them with matters(name); a DSL capacity sees $input.<slot_name> as a list even when only one Matter is bound. Declarative: the engine does not refuse a binding that contradicts it, as it does not enforce 'required' or 'schema' either.

<field_name>.type: string | integer | boolean | array | object | any

@matter._comment: Optional. Declare matter effects. Three mutually exclusive slots.

effects.<surface_name>: One sentence describing what happens to this surface.

#root._compensated_by_note: Optional, and only meaningful when this capacity declares effects. Absolute reference to the capacity that reverses this capacity's effects. Declaring it makes the effect compensable: an orchestrating flow (or the LLM implementing one) can, when a later step fails, invoke the declared compensations of the already-completed effectful steps in reverse order. The engine does not run compensations automatically — this is a declarative contract that orchestration exploits. Omit entirely for effect-free capacities or when no meaningful reversal exists (in which case the failure sections of the transformation_contract should say what remains behind).

transformation_contract._morphing_note: Required for kind='dsl'. Engine validates this is a non-empty string.
invariants: A condition always true regardless of inputs.
success: What is guaranteed when this section succeeds.
failure: Conditions under which this section fails.
notes: Optional implementation constraints not captured elsewhere.

resolution._comment: For kind='dsl': executed by the engine. Must contain exactly one runtime node at top level. For kind='interpreted'/'compiled': declarative guidance only, not engine-executed. See capacity.dsl.reference.json for all available nodes.

#<sub_section>._comment: A sub-section is declared inline here, inside the parent resolution. It shares the same structure as #root: role, inputs, outputs, transformation_contract, resolution. Its own resolution can contain further sub-sections — the nesting is recursive.
#<sub_section>.role: One sentence describing what this stage does.

_subjective_note: Optional. Free-form space for subjective categorization. Add any key-value pairs meaningful to you or your team — tags, priority, notes, author opinions. The engine ignores this section entirely.
